Ciara and Russell Wilson Announce Pregnancy With Fifth Child

By

Tai Marie
Sep 6, 2026 9:43 PM
0
  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window)Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window)X

Instaread

Ciara and NFL quarterback Russell Wilson have announced they are expecting their fifth child. The couple shared the news through a joint social media post on Sunday, showcasing the growing family as they prepare for a new addition.

The announcement comes as the latest chapter for the high-profile pair, who have been married since 2016. Ciara, 40, revealed her pregnancy in a stylized video featuring her silhouette, confirming that the “Level Up” singer is ready to expand her household once again. Wilson, who currently plays for the Pittsburgh Steelers, shared the enthusiasm on his own platforms.

The couple already shares three children together: daughter Sienna Princess, son Win Harrison and daughter Amora Princess. Ciara also has a son, Future Zahir, from a previous relationship with rapper Future. Fans and fellow celebrities quickly flooded the couple’s comment sections with well-wishes. The pair has long been open about their desire for a large family, with Wilson previously joking in television interviews about wanting to have even more children in the future.

The pregnancy news follows a busy year for the singer, who has balanced her music career and various business ventures with motherhood. Friends close to the family said the couple is overjoyed by the news and looks forward to the journey ahead. While the due date has not been publicly disclosed, the announcement suggests the baby will arrive sometime in early 2027.
